serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `yaml-language-server` executable. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of the YAML server the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report syntax and schema validation errors in the linter.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Offer keys, values and document structure from the active schema.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show schema descriptions and anchor information on hover.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Jump from an alias to its anchor.

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: Fill the outline panel with the document's mappings and sequences.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format documents and indent new mapping and sequence entries.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename anchors and their aliases together.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer YAML fixes in the intentions list.

codeLens.title: Code Lens
codeLens.description: Show links for schemas associated with the document.

yaml.title: YAML
yaml.description: Parsing, schema and formatting options sent to the language server.

yamlVersion.title: YAML Version
yamlVersion.description: YAML specification used when a document does not choose one itself.

maxItemsComputed.title: Maximum Computed Items
maxItemsComputed.description: Maximum document symbols and folding regions computed for one document.

schemas.title: Schemas
schemas.description: Schema URI or path keys mapped to a file glob or array of globs.

disableSchemaDetection.title: Schema Detection Exclusions
disableSchemaDetection.description: File globs for which detected schemas are ignored. A modeline still takes precedence.

schemaStore.title: SchemaStore
schemaStore.description: Automatic schema associations from a SchemaStore-compatible catalog.

enable.title: Enabled
enable.description: Download the catalog and associate known schemas with matching files.

url.title: Catalog URL
url.description: URL of the SchemaStore-compatible JSON catalog.

customTags.title: Custom Tags
customTags.description: Tags accepted by the parser, optionally followed by `scalar`, `sequence` or `mapping` and a return type.

disableAdditionalProperties.title: Disallow Additional Properties
disableAdditionalProperties.description: Treat every schema object as if `additionalProperties` were false.

disableDefaultProperties.title: Hide Optional Defaults
disableDefaultProperties.description: Do not offer optional properties merely because their schema defines a default.

parentSkeletonSelectedFirst.title: Parent Skeleton First
parentSkeletonSelectedFirst.description: Require the parent object skeleton to be accepted before its properties are offered in an empty object.

hoverAnchor.title: Anchor Hover
hoverAnchor.description: Include anchor information in hover results.

hoverSchemaSource.title: Schema Source In Hover
hoverSchemaSource.description: Name the schema providing a hover description.

kubernetesCRDStore.title: Kubernetes CRD Store
kubernetesCRDStore.description: Schemas for well-known Kubernetes custom resources.

enable.title: Enabled
enable.description: Download schemas for well-known custom resource definitions.

url.title: Catalog URL
url.description: Base URL from which custom resource schemas are downloaded.

kubernetesVersion.title: Kubernetes Version
kubernetesVersion.description: Version used when a schema mapping names the `kubernetes` schema. Leave empty for the server default.

flowMapping.title: Flow Mappings
flowMapping.description: Whether object mappings written inside braces are allowed.

flowSequence.title: Flow Sequences
flowSequence.description: Whether sequences written inside brackets are allowed.

keyOrdering.title: Key Ordering
keyOrdering.description: Report mapping keys that are not in alphabetical order.

format.title: Formatting
format.description: How the built-in formatter writes YAML documents.

singleQuote.title: Single Quotes
singleQuote.description: Prefer single quotes over double quotes.

bracketSpacing.title: Bracket Spacing
bracketSpacing.description: Put spaces inside braces in flow mappings.

proseWrap.title: Prose Wrapping
proseWrap.description: How prose is wrapped at the print width.

printWidth.title: Print Width
printWidth.description: Column at which the formatter wraps content.

trailingComma.title: Trailing Commas
trailingComma.description: Keep trailing commas in JSON-like YAML segments.

http.title: HTTP
http.description: Proxy used when the server downloads schema catalogs and schemas.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: Proxy URL. Leave empty for a direct connection.

proxyStrictSSL.title: Verify Proxy Certificates
proxyStrictSSL.description: Verify the proxy certificate against the trusted certificate authorities.
